_comment: Docs-maintained overlay applied by .claude/skills/sync-openapi after converting the backend swagger 2.0 schema. Descriptions here fill in ONLY when the backend operation has none - once a description is added to the flask_restx docstring, it wins. exclude_path_prefixes are stripped from the public spec regardless.

PUT /v1/customer.description: **v1 is deprecated — use the v2 endpoint instead.** Updates an existing customer's details. Changes propagate to the documents linked to this customer.

POST /v1/customer.description: **v1 is deprecated — use the v2 endpoint instead.** Creates a customer keyed by your own `id`. Sending an ID that already exists fails with `CUSTOMER_ALREADY_EXISTS` — use Update a customer to change an existing record. Customers are also created automatically when a document references an unknown `party.id`.

GET /v1/customer/ledger.description: **v1 is deprecated — use the v2 endpoint instead.** Returns a customer's payment ledger over a required date range — documents, payments, and the running balance.

GET /v1/customer/list.description: **v1 is deprecated — use the v2 endpoint instead.** Lists your customers with their basic details.

POST /v1/customer/list.description: **v1 is deprecated — use the v2 endpoint instead.** Re-links your customer IDs to existing Swipe records in bulk. Use this after changing IDs in your own system, so future calls don't create duplicate customers.

GET /v1/customer/{customer_id}.description: **v1 is deprecated — use the v2 endpoint instead.** Returns one customer's details by your `customer_id`.

DELETE /v1/customer/{customer_id}.description: **v1 is deprecated — use the v2 endpoint instead.** Deletes a customer by your `customer_id`. Deleted customers move to the Deleted tab in the dashboard.

POST /v1/doc.description: **v1 is deprecated — use the v2 endpoint instead.** Creates a document — an invoice, purchase, estimate, return, delivery challan, or subscription — based on `document_type`. Unknown `party` and `items` IDs are created automatically from the details you send; existing IDs are reused. Returns the document's `hash_id`, which addresses the document in every subsequent call, plus the IRN and QR code when `einvoice` is set. Send your own `serial_number` to make retries safe — a duplicate fails with `DUPLICATE_DOC_SERIAL_NUMBER` instead of creating a second document.

GET /v1/doc/pdf/{doc_hash_id}.description: **v1 is deprecated — use the v2 endpoint instead.** Returns the rendered PDF file for a document. The PDF uses the invoice templates and document settings configured on your Swipe account. Pass `delivery_challan=1` to get a delivery-challan copy instead.

DELETE /v1/doc/{doc_hash_id}.description: **v1 is deprecated — use the v2 endpoint instead.** Cancels an active document by its `hash_id`. The document remains in your account with a cancelled status.

POST /v1/payment.description: **v1 is deprecated — use the v2 endpoint instead.** Records a payment received from a customer. Optionally settle specific documents by pairing each `hash_id` with an `amount_paying` — partial settlement is supported and the document's payment status tracks what remains. Non-cash payment modes need a bank account configured on your account, otherwise the request fails with `MISSING_BANK_ACCOUNT`. Set `send_sms` or `send_email` to notify the customer.

PUT /v1/product.description: **v1 is deprecated — use the v2 endpoint instead.** Updates an item's master record in the catalog. This is the only way to change catalog details — item fields sent inside a document apply to that document only.

POST /v1/product.description: **v1 is deprecated — use the v2 endpoint instead.** Creates an item in your catalog keyed by your own `id`. Sending an ID that already exists fails with `PRODUCT_ALREADY_EXISTS` — use Update an item to change the catalog record. Items are also created automatically when a document references an unknown item `id`.

GET /v1/product/list.description: **v1 is deprecated — use the v2 endpoint instead.** Lists the items in your catalog.

POST /v1/product/list.description: **v1 is deprecated — use the v2 endpoint instead.** Re-links your item IDs to existing Swipe records in bulk. Use this after changing IDs in your own system, so future calls don't create duplicate items.

GET /v1/product/{item_id}.description: **v1 is deprecated — use the v2 endpoint instead.** Returns one item's catalog details by your `item_id`.

DELETE /v1/product/{item_id}.description: **v1 is deprecated — use the v2 endpoint instead.** Deletes an item by your `item_id`. Deleted items move to the Deleted tab in the dashboard.

GET /v1/subscriptions/list.description: **v1 is deprecated — use the v2 endpoint instead.** Lists subscriptions within a required date range, filterable by `status` and `customer_id`. Subscriptions are created through Create a document with `document_type=subscription`.

GET /v1/subscriptions/{subscription_hash.description: **v1 is deprecated — use the v2 endpoint instead.** Returns one subscription's details, including the invoices generated from it so far.

GET /v1/utils/gstin/{gstin}.description: **v1 is deprecated — use the v2 endpoint instead.** Looks up a GSTIN on the GST portal and returns the registered business's details. Useful for validating a party's GSTIN and prefilling their name and address.

PUT /v2/customer.description: Updates an existing customer's details. Changes propagate to the documents linked to this customer.

POST /v2/customer.description: Creates a customer keyed by your own `id`. Sending an ID that already exists fails with `CUSTOMER_ALREADY_EXISTS` — use Update a customer to change an existing record. Customers are also created automatically when a document references an unknown `party.id`.

GET /v2/customer/ledger.description: Returns a customer's payment ledger over a required date range — documents, payments, and the running balance.

GET /v2/customer/list.description: Lists your customers with their basic details.

POST /v2/customer/list.description: Re-links your customer IDs to existing Swipe records in bulk. Use this after changing IDs in your own system, so future calls don't create duplicate customers.

GET /v2/customer/{customer_id}.description: Returns one customer's details by your `customer_id`.

DELETE /v2/customer/{customer_id}.description: Deletes a customer by your `customer_id`. Deleted customers move to the Deleted tab in the dashboard.

POST /v2/doc.description: Creates a document — an invoice, purchase, estimate, return, delivery challan, or subscription — based on `document_type`. Unknown `party` and `items` IDs are created automatically from the details you send; existing IDs are reused. Returns the document's `hash_id`, which addresses the document in every subsequent call, plus the IRN and QR code when `einvoice` is set. Send your own `serial_number` to make retries safe — a duplicate fails with `DUPLICATE_DOC_SERIAL_NUMBER` instead of creating a second document.

GET /v2/doc/list.description: Lists documents of one `document_type` within a required date range. Filter by `payment_status` to track pending, partially paid, or fully paid documents.

GET /v2/doc/pdf/{doc_hash_id}.description: Returns the rendered PDF file for a document. The PDF uses the invoice templates and document settings configured on your Swipe account. Pass `delivery_challan=1` to get a delivery-challan copy instead.

GET /v2/doc/{doc_hash_id}.description: Returns the full details of a document by its `hash_id` — party, items, amounts, and status.

PUT /v2/doc/{doc_hash_id}.description: Replaces the contents of an existing document. Send the complete payload with every field's updated value — this is a full replacement, not a partial update. The document keeps its `hash_id`.

DELETE /v2/doc/{doc_hash_id}.description: Cancels an active document by its `hash_id`. The document remains in your account with a cancelled status.

GET /v2/ewaybill/pdf/{doc_hash_id}.description: Returns the e-way bill PDF for a document whose e-way bill has already been generated.

POST /v2/ewaybill/{doc_hash_id}.description: Generates an e-way bill for an existing document, identified by its `hash_id`. Requires the transport details: supply type, transport mode, dispatch addresses, and transporter document date. Your account must be connected to the e-way bill portal; portal rejections are returned as `PORTAL_ERROR_{code}`. By default this points to the government sandbox portal.

POST /v2/inventory/stock.description: Records a manual stock movement for a product — `in` adds stock, `out` removes it. Use `warehouse_id` -1 for the default warehouse and `record_date` to backdate the movement. Sales and purchase documents also move stock automatically.

GET /v2/inventory/warehouses/list.description: Returns all warehouses with their IDs, for use in stock operations.

POST /v2/payment.description: Records a payment received from a customer. Optionally settle specific documents by pairing each `hash_id` with an `amount_paying` — partial settlement is supported and the document's payment status tracks what remains. Non-cash payment modes need a bank account configured on your account, otherwise the request fails with `MISSING_BANK_ACCOUNT`. Set `send_sms` or `send_email` to notify the customer.

GET /v2/payment/list.description: Lists payments recorded within a required date range.

PUT /v2/product.description: Updates an item's master record in the catalog. This is the only way to change catalog details — item fields sent inside a document apply to that document only.

POST /v2/product.description: Creates an item in your catalog keyed by your own `id`. Sending an ID that already exists fails with `PRODUCT_ALREADY_EXISTS` — use Update an item to change the catalog record. Items are also created automatically when a document references an unknown item `id`.

GET /v2/product/list.description: Lists the items in your catalog.

POST /v2/product/list.description: Re-links your item IDs to existing Swipe records in bulk. Use this after changing IDs in your own system, so future calls don't create duplicate items.

GET /v2/product/{item_id}.description: Returns one item's catalog details by your `item_id`.

DELETE /v2/product/{item_id}.description: Deletes an item by your `item_id`. Deleted items move to the Deleted tab in the dashboard.

GET /v2/subscriptions/list.description: Lists subscriptions within a required date range, filterable by `status` and `customer_id`. Subscriptions are created through Create a document with `document_type=subscription`.

GET /v2/subscriptions/{subscription_hash.description: Returns one subscription's details, including the invoices generated from it so far.

GET /v2/utils/gstin/{gstin}.description: Looks up a GSTIN on the GST portal and returns the registered business's details. Useful for validating a party's GSTIN and prefilling their name and address.

PUT /v2/vendor.description: Updates an existing vendor's details. Changes propagate to the documents linked to this vendor.

POST /v2/vendor.description: Creates a vendor keyed by your own `id`. Vendors are the parties on purchase-side documents. They are also created automatically when a document references an unknown vendor `party.id`.

GET /v2/vendor/ledger.description: Returns a vendor's payment ledger over a required date range — documents, payments, and the running balance.

GET /v2/vendor/list.description: Lists your vendors with their basic details.

POST /v2/vendor/list.description: Re-links your vendor IDs to existing Swipe records in bulk. Use this after changing IDs in your own system, so future calls don't create duplicate vendors.

GET /v2/vendor/{vendor_id}.description: Returns one vendor's details by your `vendor_id`.

DELETE /v2/vendor/{vendor_id}.description: Deletes a vendor by your `vendor_id`. Deleted vendors move to the Deleted tab in the dashboard.
